results.title: Divisibility conditions for $D$-Carmichael numbers $3qr$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $D$ be an integer, let $q < r$ be primes with $3 < q$, and write $\alpha = (D \mid 3)$, $\beta = (D \mid q)$ and $\gamma = (D \mid r)$ for the Jacobi symbols. If $3qr$ is a $D$-Carmichael number, then $q - \beta$ divides $3r - \alpha\gamma$ and $r - \gamma$ divides $3q - \alpha\beta$; moreover $r = 3q + 2\gamma$ if $\gamma = -\alpha\beta$, and $2r = 3q + \gamma$ if $\gamma = \alpha\beta$.

results.title: Spaces of type $\{F_o\}$

results.title: Mazur and Orlicz's Problem 26 has a negative answer

results.caption: Definition

results.title: Spin monomial with given exponents
results.caption: Definition

results.title: Configuration sum of a spin monomial is nonnegative
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The sum of a spin monomial over all configurations is nonnegative.

results.title: Being a spin monomial
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: `f` is a spin monomial `∏_x σ_x^{m_x}` for some exponents `m`.

results.title: Nonnegativity of the GKS positivity kernel
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The positivity kernel of the GKS inequalities: for nonnegative `c_i, d_i` and spin monomials `fac i`, `obs`, the configuration sum of `obs · ∏_i (c_i + d_i · fac_i)` is nonnegative.

results.title: Spin product over a vertex set
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The spin product `σ_A = ∏_{x ∈ A} σ_x`.

results.title: Finite-volume Ising expectation
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The finite-volume Ising expectation `⟨f⟩ = ∑_s P(s) f(s)` of an observable `f`.

results.title: Boltzmann weight as a product of cosh-plus-sinh factors
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The Boltzmann weight factorizes as a product over edges and vertices of `cosh + sinh · σ` terms.

results.title: First Griffiths inequality (GKS I)
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For the ferromagnetic Ising model on a finite graph with `β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, every spin correlation is nonnegative: `0 ≤ ⟨σ_A⟩`.

results.title: Pointwise product of two configurations
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The pointwise product of two configurations: spin `σ_y σ'_y` at `y` (`true` when the spins agree).

results.title: Duplicated-variable involution on configuration pairs
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The involution `(σ, q) ↦ (σ, σ q)` of pairs of configurations.

results.title: Ginibre's duplicated-variable change of variables
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Ginibre's duplicated-variable change of variables `(σ, q) ↦ (σ, σ q)` as an equivalence.

results.title: Unnormalized second Griffiths inequality
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The unnormalized second Griffiths inequality: `Z² (⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩ - ⟨σ_A⟩⟨σ_B⟩) ≥ 0`.

results.title: Second Griffiths inequality (GKS II)
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For the ferromagnetic Ising model on a finite graph with `β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, spin correlations are positively correlated: `⟨σ_A⟩ ⟨σ_B⟩ ≤ ⟨σ_A σ_B⟩ = ⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩`.

results.title: Energy observable of the Ising model
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The energy observable `∑_{e ∈ E(G)} σ_x σ_y + h ∑_x σ_x`, the `β`-derivative of the log-weight.

results.title: Monotonicity of correlations
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Monotonicity of correlations (a consequence of the second Griffiths inequality): for `h ≥ 0`, every spin correlation `⟨σ_A⟩_{β,h}` is nondecreasing in `β ≥ 0` (Griffiths, J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967)).

results.title: Boltzmann weight with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The Boltzmann weight `exp(∑_{e ∈ E} J_e σ_e + ∑_x h_x σ_x)`.

results.title: Partition function with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The partition function `∑_σ wJ E J h σ`.

results.title: Gibbs expectation with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The Gibbs expectation `⟨f⟩_{E,J,h} = ∑_σ f(σ) w(σ) / Z`.

results.title: Griffiths' second inequality for inhomogeneous couplings
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Griffiths' second inequality for nonnegative couplings and fields: `⟨σ_A⟩⟨σ_B⟩ ≤ ⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩`. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, "Correlations in Ising ferromagnets I", J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967) 478–483; J. Ginibre, "General formulation of Griffiths' inequalities", Comm. Math. Phys. 16 (1970) 310–328. See also `gks_second` (GKS2) for uniform couplings.

results.title: Griffiths monotonicity of correlations in the edge set
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Griffiths monotonicity: adding edges with nonnegative couplings increases every correlation `⟨σ_A⟩`. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, "Correlations in Ising ferromagnets I", J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967) 478–483.

results.title: Edge-removal ratio of partition functions
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The edge-removal ratio `ζ(S) = (Z_{E∖S} / Z_E) ∏_{e ∈ S} cosh J_e`.
